pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Remove.bg subscription plans begin at Lite for $9/month (40 credits), with the Pro plan at $39/month ($35.10/month annually) for 200 credits, and Volume+ at $89/month ($80.10/month annually) with 500 credits… Remove.bg offers a free version and starts at €3 one time for the Pay-as-you-go plan with 3 credits."

nl.tagline: Achtergrond verwijderen in één klik, ook via API
nl.description: remove.bg, oorspronkelijk van het Oostenrijkse Kaleido en nu onderdeel van Canva, haalt automatisch de achtergrond uit foto's van producten, mensen en dieren. Beschikbaar via web, desktop en API voor bulkverwerking.
limitations: Gratis downloads alleen in lage resolutie

en.tagline: One-click background removal, also via API
en.description: remove.bg, originally from Austria's Kaleido and now part of Canva, automatically removes backgrounds from photos of products, people and animals. Available on web, desktop and via API for bulk processing.
limitations: Free downloads only in low resolution
